    ae_codes = autoencoder.encoder(x_train)

Yes.
Its mean squared error per pixel is `r sprintf("%.3f", py$ae_mse)`,
against `r sprintf("%.3f", py$mean_mse)` for the mean image.
Two numbers per image remove `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * py$error_removed)` of the mean image's squared error.
